summary: VERIFICATION run (iteration 2) of GIZMOVO storefront. Backend: 47 existing pytest cases (backend_test.py) now 47/47 PASS — all 4 iteration-1 defects (regex 500 on /api/search & /api/products?search, missing GET /api/orders/{order_no}, contact blank-field validation) are fixed. Added 25 new cases in test_verification_iter2.py covering out-of-stock enforcement, regex metacharacter hardening, categories, checkout->order deep-link, MAX_QTY=5 and contact validation — 25/25 PASS (backend 72/72 = 100%). Frontend: verified every requested item end-to-end at 1920/1440/390px — sold-out states (shop + PDP), categories dropdown, cart cross-sell, payment badges (checkout + footer), mobile sticky buy bar, search overlay incl. regex metacharacter graceful empty state, full guest purchase flow (order GZ260827B02566 placed, cart cleared), cold deep-link order confirmation now renders full summary, contact form, FAQ accordion, 404, Escape-to-close drawer, qty cap 5, no duplicate data-testids on homepage, zero horizontal overflow, zero broken images, zero console/page errors. ONE new defect found: the navbar Categories trigger closes the dropdown on a plain mouse click (hover opens it, then onClick toggles it shut).

ui_bugs.issue: Categories dropdown cannot be opened by CLICKING. The wrapper has onMouseEnter={() => setCatOpen(true)} and the trigger has onClick={() => setCatOpen((o) => !o)}. A real mouse click always fires mouseenter first (open=true), then the click toggles it back to false — so the panel flashes open and immediately closes. Only pure hover (or keyboard Enter without a pointer) works. Verified: page.hover -> dropdown appears; page.click -> dropdown count = 0. Fix: make the trigger onClick set open unconditionally (setCatOpen(true)) or remove the hover-open and use click + outside-click/Escape handling.

issues: No horizontal overflow on /, /shop, /products/:slug (in-stock and sold-out), /checkout, /cart, /contact, /faq, /404 at 390px and 1440px — clean.
All 21 images on /shop load (0 broken) with the new imgUrl downscaling; PDP/cart/upsell thumbnails render.
Mobile sticky bar is correctly pinned to the bottom (y+h == viewport height) and hidden on desktop; for the sold-out product it renders as a disabled 'Sold out' bar with no pdp-sticky-add — correct.
Minor: the 'added to bag' toast renders bottom-right over the footer/newsletter area on the order-confirmation page; readable but slightly overlaps footer content.
Carry-over from iteration 1 (still present): checkout input placeholders (Aarav Sharma / you@email.com / 400001) are low contrast on white.

action_items: MEDIUM: Fix Navbar Categories trigger so a mouse CLICK opens (not closes) the dropdown — hover-open + click-toggle currently cancel each other out. Hover and mobile menu paths work fine.
critical_code_review_comments: Navbar.jsx:57-65 — combining onMouseEnter open with a click toggle on the same element is inherently conflicting on pointer devices; use hover-open + click-open (never toggle) or a single controlled pattern.
server.py:320 — @app.on_event('startup')/'shutdown' remain deprecated; migrate to the FastAPI lifespan context manager.

server.py:208-229 add_item() — read-modify-write on carts.items is still non-atomic (find_one, then insert_one, then update_one); concurrent adds from two tabs can drop a line. Use a single upsert with $push/$set array filters.
server.py seed() upserts products on every boot but never prunes removed slugs, so stale products persist in the DB.
CartDrawer.jsx:23-27 — upsell recs are fetched once and cached in state keyed on recs.length, so if the fetch fails it retries forever on every open; consider a 'loaded' flag.

Out-of-stock is enforced on POST /api/cart/items but NOT re-validated in POST /api/checkout — an item that goes out of stock while sitting in a cart can still be ordered. Recommend re-checking availability at checkout.

rca_of_the_issue: Navbar categories dropdown: the container <div className="relative" onMouseEnter={() => setCatOpen(true)} onMouseLeave={() => setCatOpen(false)}> opens the panel as soon as the pointer enters. The inner button additionally does onClick={() => setCatOpen((o) => !o)}. Because a pointer click is always preceded by mouseenter, state is already true when the click handler runs, so the toggle sets it to false and the dropdown closes instantly. Reproduction: Playwright page.click('[data-testid="nav-categories"]') -> categories-dropdown never becomes visible; page.hover(...) -> it appears and nav-cat-* navigation to /collections/{slug} filters the grid correctly (verified: audio = 2 products, desk = 3 products). Mitigation: change the button handler to setCatOpen(true) (or drop hover-open in favour of click-open with an outside-click listener).
